segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin describe the cleanser as removing makeup and refreshing without feeling stripped, including one who calls it a holy grail despite dark marks from acne.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report gentle exfoliation, no clogged pores, and reduced dark spots without dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers say the cleanser does not leave their face feeling stripped, overstripped, or irritated, and one notes it does not irritate the eye area.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin reports visibly brighter, softer skin with no drying effect, while another separately notes the product can feel a little drying.

concerns.aging: One reviewer using it alongside a retinaldehyde routine reports smooth, glowing skin with no negative effects mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe skin as clean but not stripped or dry; one reviewer explicitly found it a little drying and another wished it were more moisturizing, though several others report no dryness at all.
concerns.redness: No reviewers report increased redness; several with sensitive or reactive skin describe the cleanser as non-irritating.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as gentle and non-stripping to the skin barrier, with no reports of barrier damage or reactions.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report a reduction in dark spots, hyperpigmentation, or acne marks and an overall brighter, more even skin tone after regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and describe the cleanser as helping avoid clogged pores; no reviewer describes new blemishes from use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers describe the cleanser as cleaning thoroughly without over-stripping natural oils, leaving skin feeling fresh rather than oily.

aspects.libelle: Limited improvement over previous Naturium cleanser

extraits.texte: Bought this about 2 weeks ago and I LOVE IT SO MUCH! My skin feels super clean without feeling stripped. I have acne prone oily skin with dark marks from acne and I feel super fresh and glowy with this cleanser. I want to bathe it it's so refreshing. If you like the gelee cleanser you'll love this!!!!! It's my main cleanser AM AND PM forever!

Cleans my skin well, even full makeup. It is a little drying though. But I just use my serums and moisturizers after! I feel like my dark spots don't look as deep and that's a big win for me! I have oily/combo skin, deep skin tone, hyperpigmentation and occasional hormonal acne even in my 30s. I would recommend this!

I lean more combo/acne-prone, and this cleanser has very quickly become my new holy grail morning cleanser to gently exfoliate any dead skin cells from my tretinoin the night before while also "clearing the decks" so that I don't risk any clogged pores during the day (I use the Niacinamide Cleansing Gelee at night to focus on hydration without irritating my skin while using tret). The brightening benefits are great (I saw a reduction in dark spots pretty quickly), and my sensitive skin is never left feeling stripped or irritated. If you're looking for a gentle exfoliating cleanser, this is it!
I love this cleanser. It removes my makeup without having to do a double cleanse. The refreshing formula leaves my sensitive face clean but not feeling overstripped.

extraits.titre: Experienced my softest, cleanest skin ever!
extraits.texte: I am a skincare enthusiast and brand loyalist, having used some of my favorite skincare brands for decades. Naturium's Glow Getter caught my eye while searching for new bodywash and I haven't looked back. I put this vitamin C cleanser on dry skin, rubbed in and rinsed it off and wow! Not only was my skin SO clean, it was visibly brighter, without any drying effects. Here is a video of me using it, my skin looks like I have a filter on it, I don't. I washed my face for 60 secs and haven't touched my go-to brands since.

Seems like a good cleanser (bought it becaue the Vit C body wash is so good) BUT I can't get over the weird smell. One of the resons I like Naturium is because most things are unscented and maybe this is technically unscented but if so, EWWWWWW. Hard to get past. I'll use up the bottle because the product does seem very cleansing and I think it's moderately effective, but might be the first thing from Naturium that I do not repurchase

extraits.titre: Not as Good as Mixed Greens Cleanser
extraits.texte: I bought this as a replacement for the Mixed Greens Nutrient Rich Cleanser (which has been sold out for months). After two weeks I am not seeing improvement in brightness, but it also doesn't seem to cleanse as well as previous Naturium cleansers. This is the first product I am disappointed in purchasing.
